sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Remained on standby at HQ while charging the Ops Phone, which was at 9% battery; awaiting sufficient charge before commencing patrols.
Ops Phone battery reached 33%; commenced patrols.
Commenced Alpha Route. Arrived at check-in at the intersection of Victoria Street East and Queen Street; ongoing footpath construction observed in the area.
Maintained a visible security presence near the intersection of Victoria Street East and Queen Street, remaining under shelter due to wet weather.
Response call received regarding an altercation on Darby Street; proceeded immediately to the location.
Arrived at Darby Street and encountered a male individual lying on the ground screaming in apparent pain; approached to assess the situation and provide assistance.
Assisted the male individual to the side of the area; Police arrived shortly afterwards to attend the incident.

An off-duty Auckland Council warden at a nearby restaurant had witnessed the altercation between the male and a female individual. Police attended and took control of the situation; the team remained on standby to assist if required.
Continued maintaining security presence at Darby Street while Police remained on-site.
Police departed the area; continued standby to monitor for further disturbances.

Response call from Health Souvenirs at 63 Albert Street regarding a hole made in the exterior wall by an unknown person; staff concerned that potentially flammable material could be present and requested assistance.
Departed Darby Street and proceeded towards Health Souvenirs to investigate the reported hazard.

Arrived at Health Souvenirs and inspected the hole in the exterior wall. Located hand sanitiser, identified as flammable, and removed it to a nearby dumpster. Reassured staff that the immediate concern had been addressed; remained on standby while maintaining security presence.
Maintained a visible security presence at the intersection of Wyndham Street and Albert Street before resuming scheduled patrol routes.
Continued welfare checks on businesses along Queen Street towards Britomart Square.
Maintained security presence at the intersection of Swanson Street and Lower Albert Street.
Departed the standby area; welfare check, all clear:
Welfare check at Zibetto Espresso Bar, Palmer Bar, Ronnie's Cafe, Woolworths Lower Albert Street, Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Completed a walkthrough and security check of Weirco Lane, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in point and completed a full security sweep of the surrounding area, all clear.
Remained on standby under shelter at Commercial Bay due to ongoing wet weather.
Welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, Adidas, Movenpick Hotel, all clear.
Welfare check at Western Union Money Exchange and Q Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check and security sweep around the Imperial Lane building.
Welfare check at Cooke's, Fable, Luxury Karaoke, Quest, Cartier, all clear.
Response call from Romanis regarding three individuals allegedly pressuring customers to purchase food for them; staff advised they had left the area on bicycles. Proceeded to the location.
Arrived at Romanis and spoke with staff regarding the incident; advised staff to contact security immediately if the individuals returned.
Maintained a visible security presence outside Romanis to reassure staff and the public while monitoring for the individuals' return.

As the team prepared to leave Romanis, the three individuals returned on their bicycles. They were approached and instructed not to return to the premises; they responded dismissively before riding away. Standby extended to monitor for further disturbances (17:15–17:35, no further incidents).
Departed Romanis and returned towards HQ to charge the Ops Phone, which was at 10% battery.
Welfare check at Wilson Carpark on Fort Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Vape Haven, Evans Kebab, Haven Mart, all clear.
Visual welfare check of Vulcan Lane from Queen Street, all clear.
Returned to HQ to conduct the mandatory building security sweep.
Remained on standby at HQ recharging the Ops Phone, which had lost power before the building sweep could commence.
Ops Phone battery reached 12%; continued charging towards approximately 30% to support uninterrupted patrol operations.
Ops Phone battery reached 29%; commenced the mandatory building security sweep.
Completed the mandatory building security sweep, no issues identified. Resumed scheduled patrol routes.
Continued the remaining sections of Alpha Route.
Observed that most retail businesses had closed for the evening, with several continuing to operate into the late evening and early morning.
Welfare check at Cotton On and Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Maintained a visible security presence at the intersection of Wellesley Street and Queen Street.
Arrived at the Skyworld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square check-in point; maintained a visible security presence in the centre of Aotea Square.
Welfare check at Bar & Cafe, all clear.
Welfare check at Jack's Fried Chicken, which remained open for trading, all clear.
Completed Alpha Route and commenced Echo Route.
Welfare check and walkthrough of the Bledisloe Building alleyway, all clear.
Welfare check around Te Waihorotiu train station, all clear.
Walkthrough and welfare check at Albert Street Convenience Store, all clear.
Welfare check at Subway, Accord Barbershop, Coffee Club, 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in point at the intersection of Federal Street and Victoria Street West, all clear.
Welfare check at Hell Pizza, The Fiddler, Mala Alley, Casa Victoria, all clear.
Welfare check at Scrunchy Miller's, City Liquor, Lord Nelson's Steakhouse and Woolworths Victoria Street West, which was closing for the evening; all clear.
Welfare check at Domino's Pizza, Fresh Market, Tandoor, Wilson Carpark and the food stalls along Elliott Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Pizza Club, Mali Thai, Celine's Mediterranean Cuisine, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in point at the intersection of Darby Street and Queen Street, all clear.

While patrolling near Darby Street, the team was approached by the female individual involved in the earlier 15:25 altercation; she enquired about her dog, which she reported had gone missing around the time of the incident.
Advised the female that the team would follow up with Auckland Council to establish whether a lost dog had been located in the city.
Welfare check at Dunkin' Donuts, Hazy Tiger, BBQ King Restaurant, all clear.
Continued patrols along Queen Street towards Shortland Street.
Arrived at the check-in point at the intersection of Shortland Street and Queen Street, all clear.
Arrived at the Queens Arcade check-in point, all clear.
Completed Echo Route and commenced Beta Route.
Walkthrough and security check of Pocket Park.
Welfare check at The Right Track Sports Bar, Evans Kebab, Vape Haven, Jo & Joe, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in point at the intersection of Gore Street and Customs Street East, all clear.
Welfare check at Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Security walkthrough and welfare check of Wilson Carpark on Fort Street, all clear.
Walkthrough of O'Connell Street with welfare checks at Wafflers and More, Ground Wine Bar, Gilt Brasserie, all clear.
Arrived at the Chancery Square and Freyberg Square check-in point, both areas clear. Ops Phone battery at 5%, requiring a return to HQ for charging.
Arrived at HQ and commenced charging the Ops Phone.
Commenced scheduled 30-minute meal break at HQ.
Meal break completed; remained on standby at HQ awaiting the incoming Night Shift for handover.
Afternoon shift concluded; handover to the Night Shift completed successfully.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Remained on standby at HQ while charging the Ops Phone in preparation for patrols.
Departed HQ and commenced patrols while responding to a call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding an individual inside the premises.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street and observed an individual remaining inside the restaurant without purchasing anything.
Approached the individual and instructed him to move along; he complied without incident. No further issues reported.
Welfare check at 77 Convenience Store on Queen Street, all clear. Commenced a full security sweep of Upper Queen Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Upper Queen Street, all clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced a full security sweep of the area.
Completed a full security sweep of Aotea Square, all clear. Remained on standby for nearby response calls.
Concluded standby at Aotea Square; no incidents occurred and no response calls received. Continued patrols towards Mayoral Drive and Federal Street.

Completed patrols along Mayoral Drive and Federal Street, both areas clear. Observed a gathering of patrons outside The Fiddler Irish Bar and maintained a visible security presence in the surrounding area.
Welfare check at The Fiddler Irish Bar and 77 Convenience Store, both clear with no disturbances. Continued patrols along Federal Street.
Completed a full security sweep of Federal Street and St Patrick's Square, both areas clear.
Arrived outside Ace Karaoke and maintained a visible security presence while monitoring patrons and the surrounding area.
Departed Ace Karaoke after a large group of patrons had left the premises; no incidents reported.
Welfare check at Albert Street Convenience Store, all clear.
Completed a full security sweep of Albert Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Provedor, where a Latin-themed party was taking place; maintained a visible security presence due to the event and increased patron activity.
Completed a follow-up welfare check at Provedor, all clear with no disturbances. Continued patrols.
Arrived at Andrew Andrew and conducted a welfare check; remained on standby while maintaining security presence around the venue.
Completed a follow-up welfare check at Andrew Andrew, all clear.
Conducted a welfare check with the marina security guards; no issues or concerns reported. Continued patrols along Quay Street towards Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay and commenced a full security sweep of the area.
Completed a full security sweep of Commercial Bay, all clear. Also conducted a welfare check at McDonald's Britomart, no concerns reported.
Completed a full security sweep of Fort Street and Wilson Carpark with a welfare check at Jo & Joe, all clear. Remained on standby at Imperial Lane for nearby response calls.
Continued monitoring Fort Street and Imperial Lane; both areas remained clear with no disturbances or response calls.
Completed a full security sweep of High Street and Shortland Street, both clear. Continued towards Chancery Square and maintained a visible security presence.
Completed security checks at Chancery Square, all clear. Departed towards HQ for a scheduled 30-minute break.
Remained on standby at HQ while charging the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Continued charging the Ops Phone at HQ while remaining available for nearby response calls.
Remained on standby at HQ awaiting the incoming Morning Shift for handover.
Night shift concluded; handover to the Morning Shift completed successfully.
